info.title: AcornOps Control Plane API
info.description: Control plane API for workspaces, targets, Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, sessions, runs, auth, and internal execution wiring.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: OIDC, password, browser session, and external integration account link endpoints.

tags.name: workspaces
tags.description: Workspace, target, Kubernetes cluster, and VM management endpoints.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Durable webhook subscriptions, lifecycle-aware delivery, and attempt history.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Run query, cancel, and stream endpoints.

tags.name: workflows
tags.description: Workspace workflow definitions, schedules, sessions, and approval inbox endpoints.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: MCP registries, destination-bound browsing, scoped MCP imports, and credential connections.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Workspace-scoped custom agent definitions, triggers, versions, tests, and activity.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Operator-only admin API protected exclusively by admin bearer tokens.

parameters.description: Exact workspace ID or case-insensitive workspace-name substring.
